name: 工作簿完整性与模板残留候选扫描
purpose: Detect deterministic workbook defects and bounded review candidates before semantic analysis.
assumptions: OOXML cell states are mechanically readable while bounded scans may report lower bounds
human_gates: review percent-format candidates against field definitions
confirm configured or repeated text is outside the workbook scope before calling it contamination
diagnostics: scan truncation, declared-dimension state, formula-error completeness, and candidate counts
allowed_claims: declared dimension is smaller than observed populated range
candidate requires field-definition or scope review
forbidden_claims: percent value above 100 percent is always wrong
a configured term proves publication or business impact
a truncated observed dimension is the worksheet data boundary
formula error counts from a truncated scan are complete
